stories.title: India, Finland to deepen economic ties via startup cooperation
stories.summary: Finnish Ambassador Mikko Kivikoski said India and Finland will focus on startup collaboration to strengthen their economic relationship. At the “Polar Bear Pitching” event, Indian startup founder Yash Goliya secured a place to compete globally in 2027. Trade between the two countries has been increasing in recent years.
stories.why: Startup links can draw investment and help expand bilateral trade.
